description_excerpt: Join our team as a Services Engineer and become the technical expert our customers rely on. You'll deliver hands-on installation, maintenance, and repair services that keep critical systems running safely and efficiently while building lasting customer relationships. What will you do? This position is accountable for installing, inspecting, maintaining, troubleshooting and repairing customer equipments for Cooling systems of Schneider Electric. Services Engineer will maintain, retrofit, and provide technical support for all Schneider products, both in the shop and on site. Services Engineer…
